title: Countdown
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels with a number that counts down. In the first, a big digit on a brick building counts 9 to 0 and the door under it opens at 0. In the second, two digits count 99 to 00 and the floor is a trapdoor that opens at 00, dropping you onto a soft mat. A digit here is a row of blocks that each turn into the next number after a time. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change how long the count lasts.

box.back: A small explorer in a gold beanie has two short rooms and a number in each that counts down. At 0 the door opens and you may leave. At 00 the floor opens and you must. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change how long the count lasts.
features: A big number that counts 9 to 0, and a door that opens at 0
Two digits that count 99 to 00, and a trapdoor floor at 00
Made to be copied and taken apart
